findings.issue: The 2mp sequential perfect is rendered with the ustedes future, which is licensed, but that form is also 3pl and is coordinated with the 3cp fall verb, so the pursuers and the 2mp suffix on the enemies can be read as a third party (they pursue their enemies) rather than the addressees.

notes: Caerán matches 3cp; delante de ustedes and a espada match the 2mp suffix and singular sword.
